latestVersion.changelog:
Agent Anchor 1.0.0 — First public release

- Introduces a crash-proof dashboard for OpenClaw, with automatic state snapshots for seamless agent recovery.
- Task Tracker feature organizes work into In Progress, Staged, and Completed.
- Live Terminal View displays system status, connection health, and agent activity.
- Cron Job Monitoring enables real-time oversight and one-click error resolution.
- Activity Calendar and click-to-expand details for deep task and job inspection.
- Simple Python server setup; requires OpenClaw, Python 3, and a web browser.
